name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Combobox (Base UI in both shadcn versions). The input is the kit input group: a 2px ink line on paper that thickens on hover (G3, fields) and gets 3px + paper + ink on focus; aria-invalid gives an accent line, a "!" mark and a serrated edge; disabled gives a dashed line and a tone frame. The chevron is a brush mark (mark-chevron) that turns when open; the clear button is a small 2px square that inverts on hover. The popup is a case (3px ink line, tone shadow) with a notch toward the input, popping in over three frames. The highlighted item inverts to ink; the chosen item gets a brush check that draws itself; disabled items keep the label with a dashed underline. Group labels are underlined lettering; the separator is a fine ink rule; the empty state is a solid-line box with a "…" mark and lettering. Chips (multiple) are drawn like Badge (2px frame, lettering, square) with a remove cell that inverts; focus stays inside the chip; chips wrap. Rows are 44px tall under 640px. Exports the class strings of the popup, item, label, empty state and chip for static look-alikes.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/combobox". It wraps your own components/ui/combobox (shadcn ships the same Base UI Combobox in its Radix and Base UI versions) and reuses the look of "@/components/ui/manga/input-group".

meta.tagline: Type to find; the list pops in as a notched case and marks your pick with a brush check.
meta.usage:
import { Combobox, ComboboxContent, ComboboxEmpty, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem, ComboboxList } from "@/components/ui/manga/combobox"

<Combobox items={series}>
  <ComboboxInput placeholder="Find a series…" />
  <ComboboxContent>
    <ComboboxEmpty>No series found</ComboboxEmpty>
    <ComboboxList>
      {(item) => <ComboboxItem key={item} value={item}>{item}</ComboboxItem>}
    </ComboboxList>
  </ComboboxContent>
</Combobox>

props.name: showClear
props.description: On ComboboxInput: a small 2px square clear button.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: On ComboboxInput or ComboboxChipsInput: the error look on the field.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: On ComboboxContent: gap to the input (14 by default: room for the notch and the focus ring).

props.name: ComboboxChips / ComboboxChip
props.description: Multiple selection: Badge-like chips that wrap, with a remove cell.
